scope: Reachable student interface from lib/main.dart -> AuthWrapper -> UserDashboardScreen plus conditional registration/reset routes
method: Read-only inspection of source and previously completed Flutter reports. This inventory does not execute application requests or create application data.
userConstraint: All new application data and acceptance evidence must come from real UI actions. Do not run fixtures, seeds, HTTP mutation scripts or mocked suites for new acceptance results.

statusMeaning.pending: No real UI evidence is recorded in this inventory. Existing automated tests do not mark the real interface as passed.

requiredCommonChecks: Control reachable by pointer/touch and keyboard where applicable
Loading, empty, failure and success states where implemented
No secrets or student identity exposed to another role
Return navigation keeps the current authenticated identity

previousAutomation.label: Automated tests executed earlier; not real-interface acceptance

reachabilityNotes: Category headings in the cafeteria menu are read-only grouping; no interactive category/price filter exists on the reachable student route.
The tune icon in the home search banner belongs to the single search tap target; it does not open a separate filter dialog.
Activos/Historial/Favoritos are navigation tabs; no independent arbitrary order-status filter is exposed.
No chat entry is reachable in the current student screen graph inspected here; do not mark a student chat UI as tested.
Payment selection records a method; the student confirmation expressly does not charge money.
Registration/recovery actions require server auth/options selfRegistration and working mail to complete; an unavailable prerequisite is not a passed UI test.
Old lib/features/business screens and old auth login/register/role-selection files are not reachable from the current root AuthWrapper; excluded from student acceptance inventory.
LocalRegistrationHint is compile-time conditional and excluded from the normal institutional build; a demo hint is not student production behavior.
Order state is explicitly refreshable in the reachable student UI; this inventory does not claim push/WebSocket notification delivery.
